Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Max. Max loved to run and play with his friends in the park. One day, Max saw a little boy named Tim. Tim wanted to play with Max, so he asked his mom, "Can we play with Max, please?"
His mom said, "Yes, let's play catch!" Max and Tim played catch with a ball. Max was so good, and he always threw the ball. Tim was very good at the game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue liked to play outside in the sun. One day, Sue saw a big puddle. She thought it would be fun to jump in it.
Sue jumped in the puddle and laughed as she splashed water everywhere. She saw a tiny bug on the ground near the puddle. Sue thought the bug looked disgusting too. So, she did not watch the bug.
When Sue was done jumping in the puddle, she fell down. The bug looked at her and said, "I'm sorry, Sue. I was scared of the puddle too." Sue and the bug became friends. They played in the sun together until the sun went down. And from that day on, Sue and the bug were always in the grass.
